The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Estagiário de Pesquisas e Desenvolvimento - Vaga Afirmativa
description:
Sobre a Saint-Gobain


A Saint-Gobain projeta, fabrica e comercializa materiais e soluções pensadas para o bem-estar de cada um de nós e o futuro de todos. Eles proporcionam conforto, performance e segurança, ao mesmo tempo, em que respondem aos desafios da construção sustentável, eficiência do uso de recursos e mudança climática.


Além disso, atua há mais de 80 anos no Brasil com um portfólio diversificado de marcas tanto na indústria como no varejo. O Grupo tem mais de 12 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos no país, vendas anuais de R$ 8,1 bilhões em 2019.


Venha trabalhar conosco e fazer parte desta equipe que constrói o futuro! Junte-se a nossa equipe inovadora, apaixonada e empreendedora e venha criar um novo mundo com a gente! Seja Estagiário(a) em Sumaré–SP.


Sobre PPS:

PPS é um hub de 5 negócios do grupo Saint-Gobain:


ENC Bearings & Seals, Life Sciences, Sefpro, Tapes Solutions & Films e Zirpro / Special Grains & Powders.


Para construir o futuro com a gente, você terá as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Realização de testes laboratoriais e de produção (trials) para novos produtos e/ou matérias-primas
  • Realização de testes em conformidade com normas técnicas específicas para novos produtos.
  • Atuação em demandas gerais de desenvolvimento de novos produtos.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios Técnicos
  • Elaboração de Instrução de Trabalho


Para se transformar junto com a nossa equipe, você precisa de:


  • Engenharia Química, Química ou Engenharia de Materiais
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Pacote Office;


Além de uma experiência inovadora, você terá:


  • Bolsa auxílio compatível com o mercado;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Seguro de vida em grupo;
  • Wellhub (Gympass)


Onde quer que esteja presente, o Grupo Saint-Gobain promove a diversidade das equipes para construção de uma cultura aberta e de engajamento. Para atingir crescimento sustentável, nos apoiamos na diversidade das comunidades onde operamos localmente. Integramos e cultivamos nossas diferenças, criando um ambiente que promove o equilíbrio e a igualdade, essenciais para o crescimento profissional.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript + React)
description:
Role Overview: Own full-stack product end-to-end. Lead Product engineering role with strong ownership, full direct communication with the client and AI workflows.

Experience Level: 7+ years

Location: Remote

Tech Stack: TypeScript + React, Prisma, Fastify, Mantine

Contract Type: Full-time, B2B contract


About the Role

Radity  is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Our client is a US insurance company, subsidiary of Fortune 500 companies. This is an “insurance startup” with an agile culture and approach to work, and future oriented approach to technology. Product is internally developed Claims Management system. The product is in the early development stage. Once MVP goes live, project will continue to stabilize the product and enhance it with new features and AI -powered workflows embedded directly into real business processes.


Radity is running software development projects with the client for more than 3 years. This is not an outsourcing role, but a real product engineering role, where you will be part of a big joint Radity and Client team. Engineers are trusted with context, real problems, and responsibility for delivering outcomes.


You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and sometimes clients to design, build, and evolve a complex platform used by insurance professionals every day.


What You’ll Do

  • Own features end to end — from understanding the business problem to solution design, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Design and build backend services using TypeScript, Prisma and Fastify
  • Develop modern frontend features using React and TypeScript
  • Work with PostgreSQL
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform architecture and technical standards
  • Build and integrate AI-powered workflows that support complex claims management business flows, using existing AI services and tooling where appropriate
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape solutions, not just implement requirements
  • Take responsibility for testing, CI/CD, releases, and production readiness
  • Continuously improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience
  • Use modern AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily engineering work


What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript + React, Prisma
  • Experience building and operating real production systems (not just isolated components)
  • Solid understanding of system design, architecture, and trade-offs
  • Comfort working with incomplete requirements and asking the right questions
  • Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms
  • Practical experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and deployments
  • Product-oriented mindset — focus on user value and business outcomes
  • Active, practical use of AI tools in daily development
  • Experience in client-facing or stakeholder discussions
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher


Nice to have (not required)

  • Insurtech background


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive market-level compensation based on experience and location
  • Generous vacation policy
  • Full equipment provided
  • Paid access to modern AI tools, learning resources, and subscriptions
  • Support for continuous learning and professional development
  • Strong engineering culture with high trust and autonomy


Why This Role

  • High ownership and real influence on product direction
  • Engineers are trusted to think, design, and decide, not just execute
  • Direct Exposure to the top engineering team
  • AI is a real working tool and part of the product, not a buzzword
  • Long-term product vision with solid business fundamentals


Recruitment process

  • Recruiter Screen: short intro call to align on experience, mindset, location, and compensation
  • Hiring Manager Interview: product- and case-focused discussion with an Engineering Manager (no take-home task)
  • Interview with the Client’s CTO
  • Offer

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background building AI native software to join our U.S. client. You will provide leadership and expertise to advance strategic and technical goals of our client.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um profissional de motion graphic para integrar nossa equipe em um cargo presencial, localizado no Distrito Federal, Brasil. As principais responsabilidades incluem criar animações gráficas de alta qualidade e colaborar em projetos de produção e edição de vídeos.   • Excelente capacidade de gestão de tempo e trabalho em equipe para cumprir prazos de projetos.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.
  • Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability.
  • Innovate and follow best practices.
  • Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Professional experience working in data warehousing, data architecture, and/or data engineering environments, especially using spark, hadoop, hive etc with solid understanding of streaming pipelines.
  • Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Scala, Java, Python or equivalent)
  • Good understanding of databases
  • You have built large-scale data products and understand the tradeoffs made when building these features
  • You have a deep understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms
  • You have an excellent knowledge of distributed computing frameworks such as Hadoop MapReduce, Spark
  • You have a strong knowledge of following AWS infrastructure - EMR, S3, Lambda, Redshift etc
  • You have strong understanding of data quality, governance
  • You are a team player, self-driven, highly motivated individual who loves to learn new things


Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Job Title: Implementation Analyst


English Resume Only


Location: Brazil

Type: Full-Time Contract

Setup: Fully Remote

Level: Mid-Level

Industry: Software SAAS Company

Shift: US Hours

Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000


About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Roteirista Redes Sociais (Finanças e Economia)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Roteirista de Redes Sociais (Finanças/Economia) para integrar nosso time na VAROS.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educacional. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Roteirista, você será responsável por pensar e criar os roteiros de vídeos curtos e longos sobre finanças, economia, investimento e geopolítica que serão usados nos vídeos divulgados nas redes sociais da VAROS e de seus sócios.


Você terá uma rotina dinâmica, criativa, com desafios diários, feedback constante e contato direto com os sócios, possibilitando uma rápida ascensão.


Responsabilidades

  • Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;
  • Realizar pesquisa técnica coletando informações e dados de diversas fontes para contribuir com a criação do roteiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de vídeos longos para o canal do YouTube da VAROS e/ou dos sócios (8 a 20 minutos), sobre temas de finanças, economia, geopolítica e mercado financeiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de Reels e TikToks (1 a 3 minutos) adaptando temas complexos para formatos curtos e de alto engajamento;
  • Manter consistência com o tom de voz da marca: conversacional, didático, com exemplos numéricos concretos em R$, sem jargão desnecessário;
  • Colaboração com o time de edição no intuito de garantir que a visão do roteiro seja traduzida fielmente para o vídeo final. Isso inclui revisar cortes preliminares, sugerir ajustes de ritmo, validar escolhas de gráficos e b-rolls e estar disponível pra tirar dúvidas do editor sobre intenção e timing.
  • Sugerir títulos e ideias de thumbs pensados em engajamento.


Requisitos


Formação e Experiência

  • Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;
  • 3 anos ou mais de experiência como roteirista, redator, repórter ou produtor de conteúdo;
  • Portfólio com roteiros publicados;


Hard Skills

  • Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos.
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura);


Soft Skills

  • Organização;
  • Criatividade


Ferramentas

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Notion;
  • IA (Claude, Perplexity);


Nós oferecemos:

  • Remuneração extremamente competitiva;

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.
  • Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança.
  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;


Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados .
  • Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente.
  • Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance.
  • Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação.
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiencia em gestão de pessoas
  • Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs
  • Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI
  • Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server
  • Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável)
  • Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dados


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda a Sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.


Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: LIFECYCLE & RETENTION STRATEGIST (Klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY

ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.

We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.

You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.

You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.

This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.


SCOPE OF WORK

Strategy and Campaign Planning

  • Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands
  • Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
  • Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
  • Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
  • Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
  • Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
  • Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities

Optimization and Performance

  • Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
  • Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training

Tech Stack Management and Recommendations

  • Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
  • Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.)
  • Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team

Client Collaboration

  • Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
  • Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
  • Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC
  • Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
  • Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
  • Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
  • Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
  • Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud


HOW WE WORK

You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: LIFECYCLE & RETENTION STRATEGIST (Klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY

ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.

We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.

You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.

You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.

This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.


SCOPE OF WORK

Strategy and Campaign Planning

  • Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands
  • Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
  • Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
  • Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
  • Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
  • Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
  • Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities

Optimization and Performance

  • Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
  • Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training

Tech Stack Management and Recommendations

  • Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
  • Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.)
  • Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team

Client Collaboration

  • Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
  • Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
  • Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC
  • Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
  • Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
  • Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
  • Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
  • Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud


HOW WE WORK

You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• Experience with the life science and healthcare industry.

• Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment.

• Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.


Job Description


A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening ) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening ) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)

title: Game Animator – iGaming
description:
• Game Animator | RapidPlay Games

Remoto | PJ | Full-time Produto global | Slots & Casino


Na RapidPlay Games, nossos jogos não apenas funcionam — eles encantam. Cada spin, cada transição, cada efeito conta uma história. E quem dá vida a isso é a animação.


Estamos buscando um(a) Game Animator com energia positiva, olho clínico para movimento e paixão por criar experiências visuais que prendem o jogador na tela.


Se você vê uma animação de slot e já pensa em timing, easing, impacto visual e como fazer o jogador sentir aquele \"quase lá\", essa vaga é para você.


Seu papel aqui

Você será responsável por dar vida aos nossos jogos de cassino — dos símbolos ao feedback de vitória, das transições de tela aos efeitos especiais que fazem o jogador querer mais um spin.


No dia a dia, isso significa:

  • Criar animações 2D para símbolos, personagens, UI e efeitos dentro dos jogos
  • Desenvolver motion design para transições, telas de bônus e celebrações de prêmio
  • Colaborar com game designers, artistas e devs para garantir que a animação reforce a experiência do jogador
  • Manter consistência visual e fluidez em diferentes jogos e plataformas
  • Otimizar animações para performance em web e mobile
  • Propor soluções criativas que elevem o impacto visual sem comprometer a entrega


Você terá liberdade criativa real dentro de um time que valoriza quem traz ideias.


O que é essencial

  • Experiência com animação 2D (Spine, After Effects, ou ferramentas equivalentes)
  • Conhecimento sólido de motion design (timing, easing, peso, antecipação)
  • Ter trabalhado com jogos — entender o contexto interativo, não só o linear
  • Portfólio que demonstre qualidade de movimento e atenção a detalhes
  • Perfil positivo, colaborativo e orientado a solução
  • Boa comunicação (PT + EN)


Diferenciais fortes

  • Experiência específica em iGaming (slots/casino)
  • Conhecimento em animação 3D (Blender, Cinema 4D ou similar)
  • Familiaridade com engines como Unity ou frameworks web (Pixi.js, CreateJS)
  • Interesse prático em IA aplicada a arte ou animação
  • Noção de UX e como a animação influencia o comportamento do jogador


O que você encontra aqui

  • Autonomia real (sem microgerenciamento)
  • Ambiente rápido e direto
  • Produto internacional jogado no mundo todo
  • Cultura de aprendizado contínuo
  • Espaço para inovação e experimentação visual

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified

  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform

  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Type: 12 Month Contract

Location: Fully Remote in Central and South America

Rate: $16/hr USD - $22/hr USD




Job Description


Insight Global is seeking an intermediate QA Analyst to support quality assurance and testing across AI‑enabled insurance workflows at a commercial insurance company based out of Canada. This role will focus on validating AI outputs, ensuring integration reliability, and protecting the platform from regressions as AI models and workflows evolve. Day‑to‑day responsibilities include performing manual testing, identifying test cases suitable for automation, contributing to automated regression test suites, and supporting user acceptance testing with business stakeholders. This resource will work closely with a senior QA team member to expand existing automation frameworks and ensure model changes or upgrades do not negatively impact production workflows. We are seeking an international resource based in LATAM to work closely with a team in Canada on mountain standard time. This is a fully remote 12 month engagement.


Required Skills & Experience


• Minimum 3 years of QA experience

• Strong hand-on manual testing experience

• At least 1 year of automation testing experience

• Experience with Playwright or Selenium

• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions

• Experience supporting UAT (User Acceptance Testing)

• Experience working in Agile delivery teams

• Fluent in English


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Understanding of regression testing strategies

Experience testing REST APIs

• Fluent in English

Experience testing REST APIs

Startup em constante evolução: Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e crescer!

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a senior Project Manager to join our team.

The ideal candidate must have a strong background in project management, specifically in the AI domain.


This role involves overseeing ongoing AI projects , managing client relationships , coordinating with internal teams , and ensuring the successful delivery of projects .

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.


While technical expertise is valuable, the primary focus is on project management , product ownership and client satisfaction . This role sits in the Digital Transformation Center and will be close to delivery and research teams.


  • Work model: remote from Brazil;
  • Contract type: contractor / “PJ”;
  • Availability to work according to North American’s Eastern Standard Time (EST).


Job Mission :

  • To manage AI projects, ensuring successful delivery.
  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;
  • Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring clear communication. Understand client needs, manage expectations, and address concerns promptly to achieve customer satisfaction;
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality, ensuring smooth project execution;
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, and stakeholder communications. Ensure that project status and updates are communicated effectively to both internal teams and clients;
  • Team Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment. Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support professional growth;
  • Global Approach: Interact with other regions, partners and ventures following a global approach to ensure consistency and alignment in AI project management across the organization.


Required Experience :

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field;
  • Experience in managing projects AI projects from conception to delivery;
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their applications;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools;
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges and adapt to changing project requirements;
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to assess client situation and provide actionable outcome-based business/technical advice;
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or other relevant project management certifications (preferred);
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory;
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is desirable.


Required Technical Knowledge :

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, terminology, and industry trends;
  • Understanding of project management methodologies specific to AI projects;
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and make informed project decisions based on technical considerations;
  • Proficiency in using project management software and tools for AI project tracking and management;
  • Knowledge and experience on conducting projects for IT and Service Desk solutions.
  • A background in IT environments, including an understanding of how various IT components and systems operate, is highly beneficial. This knowledge helps in navigating technical aspects, ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions within existing IT infrastructures;
  • Product ownership and ability to work in an agile environment and create user stories;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Strong project management skills.



What's next:

It's best to apply today, because job postings can be taken down and we wouldn't want you to miss this opportunity. To apply, please submit your updated English-written CV.

We are a Brazilian company with over 35 years of experience in delivering IT services worldwide, ranging from IT outsourcing to application development or IT staffing. We have a direct presence in 41 countries, through our 70 offices located throughout the world. We have managed to become the preferred partner of many small-to-midsize local and regional companies as well. title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Where you Fit In:


As a Senior QA Engineer , you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability.


You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle.


You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise.

You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly.

You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence.


The impact you will have:


  • Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis
  • Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision
  • Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization
  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards
  • Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage
  • Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems.


What we’re looking for:


Technical

  • Strong experience in automation testing
  • Advanced English
  • Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.


Execution

  • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives
  • Breaks down large challenges into structured execution plans
  • Owns quality from design through production
  • Aligns technical decisions with broader company goals.


Collaboration & Influence

  • Clearly communicates risks, trade-offs, and system impact
  • Act as a mentor to teammates and contributes to team growth
  • Builds consensus and leads by example.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
